questions.question: Three statements are given followed by three conclusions numbered I, II and III. Assuming the statements to be true, even if they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements. Statements: All leathers are shoes. Some bags are shoes. Some bags are papers. Conclusions: I. Some papers are leathers. II. Some shoes are leathers. III. Some shoes are papers.
questions.questionHtml:
Three statements are given followed by three conclusions numbered I, II and III. Assuming the statements to be true, even if they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

Statements:

All leathers are shoes.

Some bags are shoes.

Some bags are papers.

Conclusions:

I. Some papers are leathers.

II. Some shoes are leathers.

III. Some shoes are papers.
questions.solution:
The Venn diagram as per the given statements:

Conclusions:

I. Some papers are leathers. → not follow (Because there is no definite relation given between papers and leathers, so it can be possible only but not definitely true)

II. Some shoes are leathers. → Follow (All leathers are shoes, which means some shoes are leather is definitely true)

III. Some shoes are papers. → not follow (Because there is no definite relation given between shoes and papers, so it can be possible only but not definitely true)

questions.questionHtml:
Which two signs should be interchanged to make the given equation correct?

12 ÷ 5 - 8 × 2 + 14 = 70
questions.solution:
(3) ÷ and ×

⇒ 12 ÷ 5 - 8 × 2 + 14 = 70

After interchanging the signs:

⇒ 12 × 5 - 8 ÷ 2 + 14 = 70

Apply BODMAS rule:

⇒ 12 × 5 - 4 + 14

⇒ 60 - 4 + 14

⇒ 74 - 4 = 70

⇒ '12 × 5 - 8 ÷ 2 + 14 = 70'

256 - 4 × 2 + 200 ÷ 19 = 309
questions.solution:
(3) ÷ and -

⇒ 256 - 4 × 2 + 200 ÷ 19 = 309

After interchanging the signs:

⇒ 256 ÷ 4 × 2 + 200 - 19 = 309

Apply BODMAS rule:

⇒ 64 × 2 + 200 - 19

⇒ 128 + 200 - 19

⇒ 328 - 19 = 309

⇒ '256 ÷ 4 × 2 + 200 - 19 = 309'

questions.question: If the interest rate goes up, the demand for money will __________.
questions.questionHtml: If the interest rate goes up, the demand for money will __________.
questions.solution: When the interest rate increases, borrowing becomes more expensive, and people tend to save more and borrow less. So, the demand for money falls. questions.question: The concept of fundamental rights first came into being in the Magna Carta in _____________.
questions.questionHtml: The concept of fundamental rights first came into being in the Magna Carta in _____________.
questions.solution: The Magna Carta was a charter of rights agreed to by King John of England in 1215. It established the principle that everyone, including the king, was subject to the law and had certain rights that could not be taken away without due process. The concept of fundamental rights is based on the idea that there are certain rights that are inherent to all human beings, regardless of their nationality, race, or gender. These rights are often enshrined in national constitutions and international treaties.

questions.questionHtml: A solid cone with curved surface area twice its base area has slant height of 6√3 cm. Its height is:
questions.solution:
Let the radius of the cone be r units.

⇒ πrl = 2πr2 ⇒ l = 2r ⇒ r = 6√3/2 ⇒ r = 3√3

Slant height (l) of cone = √r2 + h2 ⇒ 6√32 = 3√32 + h2 ⇒ h2 = 108 - 27 = 81 ⇒ h = 9 cm

questions.question: A sum of money earns a simple interest at 7.25% per annum for the first eight years, at 8.5% for the next six years, and at 6.5% for the final four years. If the total interest earned during these eighteen years was Rs. 35,100, what was the original sum invested (in Rs.)?
questions.questionHtml: A sum of money earns a simple interest at 7.25% per annum for the first eight years, at 8.5% for the next six years, and at 6.5% for the final four years. If the total interest earned during these eighteen years was Rs. 35,100, what was the original sum invested (in Rs.)?
questions.solution:
Let the principal be ‘P’.

S.I = (P × 7.25 × 8)/100 ⇒ S.I = 58P/100

S.I = (P × 6.5 × 4)/100 ⇒ S.I = 26P/100

Total Interest in 18 years = Rs. 35,100

(58P/100) + (51P/100) + (26P/100) = 12771 ⇒ 135P/100 = 35100 ⇒ P = 26000

questions.question: If x > 0 and \(\rm x^4 + \frac{1}{x^4} = 142\) , what is the value of \(\rm x^7 + \frac{1}{x^7} \) ?
questions.questionHtml: If x > 0 and \(\rm x^4 + \frac{1}{x^4} = 142\), what is the value of \(\rm x^7 + \frac{1}{x^7} \)?
questions.solution:
x4 + 1/x4 + 2 = (x2 + 1/x2)2 ⇒ 142 + 2 = (x2 + 1/x2)2 ⇒ (x2 + 1/x 2) = √144 = 12

(x + 1/x)2 = x2 + 1/x2 + 2 ⇒  (x + 1/x)2 = 12 + 2 ⇒  (x + 1/x) = √14

x3 + 1/x3 = (x + 1/x)3 - 3(x + 1/x)  = (√14)3 - 3(√14) = 14√14 - 3√14 = 11√14

questions.question: Two successive increments of 30% each is by what percentage more than two successive decrements of 30% each? (Correct to two decimal places)
questions.questionHtml: Two successive increments of 30% each is by what percentage more than two successive decrements of 30% each? (Correct to two decimal places)
questions.solution:
Single equivalent increase of 30% each = 30 + 30 + [(30 × 30)/100] = 30 + 30 + 9 = 69%

Single equivalent decrease of 30% each = 30 + 30 - [(30 × 30)/100] = 51%

Required percentage = [(69 - 51)/51] × 100  = 18/51 × 100 = 35.29%

Sentences of a paragraph are given below in jumbled order. Arrange the sentences in the correct order to form a meaningful and coherent paragraph.

A. Swarms have wreaked havoc on crops and caused famines and mass migrations.

B. Since prehistoric times, locusts have caused plagues.

C. Traditional methods of control rely on the use of pesticides from the ground or the air, although biological control approaches are also making great strides.

D. Changes in agricultural practices and improved observation of areas where swarms tend to form have lately allowed control measures to be implemented at an earlier stage.
questions.solution: The correct arrangement of sentences is option 2) BADC. It begins with the history of locust plagues (B, A), then mentions the changes in agricultural practices leading to early control measures (D), and ends with current control methods (C).

questions.questionHtml: Direction: Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word.
questions.solution: The correct spelling is "Seize." The letter "i" comes before "e" in this word. "Seize" means to take hold of something suddenly and firmly; to grab something. Example: The thief seized her handbag and ran off with it. Other examples of words with the "ie" spelling include "believe" and "relieve".

questions.question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank No. 1.
questions.questionHtml: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank No. 1.
questions.solution: "Impart" means to communicate or convey information or knowledge to someone. Example: I was rather quiet as I didn't feel I had much wisdom to impart on the subject. The grammatical structure of the sentence suggests that a verb is needed to fill in the blank, and "impart" is the only verb option.

questions.question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank No. 2.
questions.questionHtml: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank No. 2.
questions.solution: "Across" means from one side to the other side of something. Example: The bridge across the river was long and narrow. It is the most appropriate option to fill in the blank as it implies movement from one end to the other end of something.

questions.question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank No. 3.
questions.questionHtml: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank No. 3.
questions.solution: "Trained" is the most appropriate option to fill in blank No. 3. This verb means to teach or prepare someone for a particular task or skill.  Example: She trained as an engineer.

questions.question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank No. 4.
questions.questionHtml: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank No. 4.
questions.solution: The word "enable" means to make someone or something able to do something. Example: The new laws enable more women to return to work. It is the most appropriate option to fill in the blank as it fits the context of providing the necessary capability or means to achieve something.

questions.question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank No. 5.
questions.questionHtml: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank No. 5.
questions.solution: The word "enhance" means to improve or make something better. Example: These scandals will not enhance the organization's reputation. It is the most appropriate option to fill in the blank. Grammatically, this option fits the context of the sentence and makes sense.
